name: gps-odometer
description: Turn noisy phone GPS trails into accurate kilometres: drift and glitch filtering, gap estimation, and automatic trip-end detection. Zero dependencies.
author: Padmakant Baloji

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
